description: This Java source file defines the ChartRepository class, which manages a collection of chart identifiers. It provides methods for adding, retrieving, clearing charts, and creating associated controls, along with an internal listener interface for chart-related events.

classes.name: ChartRepository
classes.description: Singleton class managing a list of chart names with methods to manipulate the collection and create controls.

classes.name: ChartRepository.ChartRepositoryListener
classes.description: Interface defining a callback method for digital chart events.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ChartRepository.

methods.name: getChart
methods.description: Retrieves the chart string at the specified index.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the total number of charts stored.

methods.name: addChart
methods.description: Adds a new chart string to the collection.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all charts from the repository.

methods.name: createControls
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ChartScrollControl with the specified listener.
